result.stderr:
SourceIntelligence MCP Server

Usage:
  sourceintelligence --stdio --repo <path>
  sourceintelligence --stdio --repo <path> --solutions UserService.slnf OrderService.slnf
  sourceintelligence --service --repo <path>
  sourceintelligence --repo <path>

Modes:
  --stdio   Force MCP stdio transport. Stdout stays protocol-clean.
  --service Run HTTP mode as a Windows Service.
  (default) If stdin is redirected, stdio is used; otherwise HTTP is started on localhost.

Configuration:
  Index:RepositoryPath            Repository to index
  Index:Port                      HTTP port (1-65535)
  Index:EnableEditTools           Enables mutating MCP tools. Defaults to true in stdio, false in HTTP.
  Index:HttpAccessToken           Optional shared token for HTTP requests.
  Index:AllowedOrigins            Optional allowed Origin values for HTTP requests.
  Index:EnableProactiveBuilds     Build graph/cognition in background at startup. Defaults to true.
  Index:StartupSolutionFilters    Ordered list of .slnf filters to pre-warm at startup (appsettings / HTTP).

Solution filter warmup (stdio):
  --solutions <filter1> [<filter2> ...]   Names or repo-relative paths of .slnf files to pre-warm.
  SOURCEINTELLIGENCE_SOLUTION_FILTERS     Comma-separated filter names (env var, all modes).
